card.name: The digit 8 inside numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 8 as the last digit of a number, such as citation numbers, claim or list numbers, years and amounts. It is strongest in reference lists and numbered items like 28 or 58.

modes.label: Citation numbers
modes.description: The digit 8 ending a reference number in a list of superscript citations.

modes.label: Numbered items
modes.description: The 8 in a numbered claim or list entry such as 28.
